blocks.text: To edit a redirection policy rule:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Private Access > Steering > Redirection Policy.

Locate the redirection policy rule you want to modify and click the Edit icon. If you only want to change a redirection policy rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter a new value on the Redirection Policy page.
Redirection policy rules that are managed by Zscaler are read only and cannot be edited or deleted.
In the Edit Rule window, modify fields as necessary. For more information about each field, see Configuring Redirection Policies.
